name: Suguro Koudai
source:
He's a student, but rarely goes to school, only attending when he feels like it. He is the son of a local powerful figure, and with no one able to tell him off, he does whatever he wants.

He is always followed by the twin sub-leaders, Kinkaku and Ginkaku.

[Translated from the [url=https://www.guilty-soft.com/product/Nightmare_x_BlackCat/]official website[/url]]
